# Vendored browser dependencies

These files are copied from the published MIT packages so the desktop app can run without a network connection or a JavaScript build step.

| Package | Version | Files |
|---|---:|---|
| `@xterm/xterm` | `5.5.0` | `xterm/xterm.js`, `xterm/xterm.css`, `xterm/LICENSE` |
| `@xterm/addon-fit` | `0.10.0` | `xterm-addon-fit/addon-fit.js`, `xterm-addon-fit/LICENSE` |

The package tarball SHA-1 values reported by `npm pack` were `275fb8f6e14afa6e8a0c05d4ebc94523ff775396` and `bebf87fadd74e3af30fdcdeef47030e2592c6f55`, respectively. Update the browser assets and this table together when changing versions.
